entries.reason: No fixed release exists. cognee declares diskcache but nothing installed imports it (grep of site-packages, 2026-10-30), so no cache is ever read. Keep it that way: do not add an import, and do not mount a shared writable directory for it.

Fixed only in 4.x, which cognee forbids (filelock<4). Every advisory is in ReadWriteLock; no installed package outside filelock itself uses it (grep of site-packages, 2026-10-30). cognee and huggingface-hub use plain FileLock.

Affects the LiteLLM proxy server (salt-key reuse). We never run or import litellm.proxy: SBAM's LLM calls go through Bifrost, litellm is only cognee's client library. Fixed in 1.100.4+, but cognee 1.6.2 caps litellm<1.97; cognee 1.6.5 lifts the cap. Bump cognee in a knowledge-lane change that runs the live Cognee suite.
